_comment: Hand-updated every game version (roughly every 6 weeks); there is no official banner API. Version 7.2 Phase 1. A character newer than the bundled data store (scripts/build-enka-data.mjs) can sit here; art and share card then use name-based Enka CDN URLs. roleTags drive the verdict rules (see src/roles.ts); pairings lists characters this one enables a strong team with.
